en: You're back. Good. This couldn't wait.
Your pigeon made that clear. What happened?
An army is attacking Highbridge. The defenses are close to breaking.
If Highbridge falls, the crossing is open. They can move on the other river towns.
They're still fighting. Reports describe masked fighters in the attacking ranks, like the ones who came after us.
Our friends with the secret master?
That's a lot of people to keep a name secret.
No name yet. But this time, they're threatening a whole town.
We're going to Highbridge. Keep your companions close; we may have to fight as soon as we arrive.
zh-CN: 你回来了，正好。这件事等不得。
你的鸽子已经提醒过我了。发生什么事？
一支军队正在进攻高桥城，城防快撑不住了。
高桥城一失守，渡口就敞开了。他们便能继续进攻沿河的其他城镇。
还在抵抗。报告说，进攻队伍中混着蒙面人，和先前袭击我们的那些很像。
又是那群替神秘主人办事的“朋友”？
这么多人，倒是谁也没把名字说漏。
名字还没查到。但这一次，受威胁的是整座城。
一起去高桥城。伙伴们别走散；一到那里，可能就得交手。
